question_selection.rationale: Multi-unit duration rule contrasting inpatient and under-24-hour day care.
Waiting-period rule with accident, continuity, and enhanced-sum-insured qualifications.
Difficult multi-page interaction between two waiting periods and the longer-period override.
Specific coverage that expressly overrides a general exclusion.
Numerical, branched table answer with network status and claim-admission condition.
Multi-fact eligibility answer assembled from three separated policy locations.
Known cross-page and fragmented MediCare Plus evidence representation case.
Known MediCare Plus extraction-representation difficulty with competing temporal and numerical clauses.
Required negative-space probe for abstention versus an unsupported automatic-termination inference.
